scope: Coverage of this representative study; not an actual OEM equipment inventory.

components.current: Stage06 separately resolves transmitter, beamformer, baseband, server and power-converter thermal surrogates with plate/radiator; variable workload and service output.
components.oneD: Integrated28-state mission and trade variants completed at representative scope.
components.threeD: Representative240×180mm board conduction field and reduced terminal paths; distinct from earlier120×80mm FEM.
components.remaining: Actual OEM board/package/junction maps, RF throughput and selected part limits unknown.

components.current: Inherited CPU, navigation and telemetry lumps with common plate; not actual hardware.
components.threeD: Earlier representative computePCB illustrates local gradients; not actual flight computer.
components.remaining: Redundancy, equipment-specific startup, IMU performance versus gradient and detailed actualPCB unresolved.

components.current: Generic60kWh energy aggregate; core/case/blanket temperatures, temperature-dependent losses and a chosen charge gate. BMS CAD envelope does not add a separate thermal state.
components.oneD: SOC, heater/charge losses and reserve interact with mission.
components.threeD: No chemistry-specific module/cell field performed in this HAPS study.
components.remaining: Selected chemistry/cell limits, module imbalance, aging, BMS heat and battery safety/qualification unresolved.

components.current: MPPT/DC-DC thermal nodes, aggregate PV temperature efficiency and electrical export.
components.oneD: Electrical-to-heat bookkeeping and shared energy demand.
components.threeD: Representative power-block/board paths; no complete harness or solar string mesh.
components.remaining: Bus droop/startup current, contact hot spots, string mismatch, degradation and harness sizing unresolved.

components.oneD: PI, cold-start, sensor/command/output delays and heater-reserve trade completed.
components.threeD: No resolved motor winding/bearing CFD or torque-speed map.
components.remaining: Selected motor allowable, bearing/lubricant/magnet data and aerodynamic power demand unknown.

components.current: Alternative CAD envelope; not combined with telecom/server as confirmed installed equipment.
components.threeD: No optical alignment/focus or detector spatial model.
components.remaining: Future alternative mission; choose sensor architecture and stability requirements before detailed study.

components.oneD: Thermal/solar exchanges within mission; no buoyancy/altitude control mass closure.
components.threeD: CAD external representation; no full thermoelastic hull or attachment stress analysis.
components.remaining: GasP/V/buoyancy feedback, current laminate allowables and structural/optical deformation unresolved.

components.current: Effective conduction and prescribed convection/radiation; board/interface and night-path trades.
components.oneD: Measured properties not available; selected sensitivity and fault comparisons completed.
components.threeD: Conduction board/plate fields; no fullHAPS external/internal CFD.
components.remaining: Actual venting/internalgas, lowdensity localflow, contact aging and raytraced view factors need data.

components.current: Explicit workload/startup and sensor/heater/contact fault cases; readiness idealtrue-state metric.
components.oneD: Temperature/service/SOC consequences compared; deliberately failed cases retained.
components.threeD: No production safety software/hardware assurance; local manufactured defect validation absent.
components.remaining: Real sensor observer, independent trips, detection/diagnostics and qualification tests required.

components.current: Chosen24h cycle at20km plus17km comparison; source/assumption separation and numeric verification.
components.oneD: Long settling windows, selected cold/hot/delay/load variants; synthetic heldout workflow.
